Full Self-Driving (Supervised)

The Future of Transport

Tesla uses billions of miles of anonymous real-world driving data to train Full Self-Driving (Supervised) to take care of the most stressful parts of daily driving while helping make the roads safer for you and others. When enabled, your vehicle will drive you almost anywhere with your active supervision, requiring minimal intervention.

View Safety Report

Full Self-Driving (Supervised) is currently available in select markets across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific with expansion to additional regions expected with future updates.1

Full Self-Driving (Supervised) is only available for activation and use in regulatory-approved markets.

Designed for Every Drive

Full Self-Driving (Supervised) intelligently and accurately completes driving maneuvers for you, including route navigation, steering, lane changes, parking and more under your active supervision. Use it for quick errands, daily commutes and road trips. Currently enabled features require active driver supervision and do not make the vehicle autonomous.

Actually Smart Summon1
Drives to You

Activate in the Tesla app and your Tesla vehicle will navigate parking spaces and tight spaces to get to you while you monitor from outside the vehicle.

Full Self-Driving (Supervised)
Drives for You2

On-board cameras with 360-degree visibility will check your surroundings, allowing your Tesla vehicle to navigate city streets and motorways alike. Tesla's vision-based AI can handle complex decisions under your supervision.

Autopark
Parks for You2

Your Tesla vehicle will automatically detect and maneuver into perpendicular and parallel parking spots for you.

Trained on Once-In-A-Lifetime Scenarios

Crashes are complex. Full Self-Driving (Supervised) is trained on what amounts to over 100 years of anonymous real-world driving scenarios from our fleet of over six million vehicles. Our fleet collectively experiences a lifetime of driving scenarios in 10 minutes.

Always Attentive,
Never Distracted

Full Self-Driving (Supervised) can take care of your daily drive, including the most common and error-prone driving tasks. Tesla vehicles are equipped with exterior cameras that enable 360-degree visibility, plus safety features that help reduce the severity of accidents or prevent them altogether. Over-the-air software updates ensure each Tesla vehicle has access to the latest safety improvements.
